CALVERTON GENERAL HOSPITAL — DISCHARGE SUMMARY

Patient: BOONE, WALTER T.   MRN: CG-448213   DOB: 11/02/1942
Admitted: 07/29/2026    Discharged: 08/02/2026
Attending: R. Okafor, MD (Cardiology)

PRINCIPAL DIAGNOSIS: Acute on chronic systolic heart failure exacerbation
SECONDARY: COPD (stable), osteoarthritis, hyperuricemia

HOSPITAL COURSE:
Patient is an 83 y/o male with known HFrEF (EF 35% on echo 3/2026) and COPD who presented to the ED with 4 days of progressive dyspnea on exertion, orthopnea, and 3.5 kg weight gain. Exam notable for bibasilar crackles and 2+ pitting edema to the knees. BNP 1240. CXR with pulmonary vascular congestion. Treated with IV furosemide with good diuresis; transitioned to oral dosing on hospital day 3. Home oxygen was not required. COPD remained at baseline; no steroids given. Patient ambulating independently with walker at discharge, O2 sat 95% on room air.

DISCHARGE MEDICATIONS:
1. Furosemide 40 mg PO daily — CONTINUED (home dose resumed after IV diuresis)
2. Carvedilol 12.5 mg PO BID — CONTINUED
3. Lisinopril 5 mg PO daily — CONTINUED
4. Spironolactone 25 mg PO daily — CONTINUED
5. Tiotropium 18 mcg inhaled daily — CONTINUED
6. Albuterol HFA 90 mcg 2 puffs q4h PRN — CONTINUED
7. Atorvastatin 20 mg PO nightly — CONTINUED
8. Aspirin 81 mg PO daily — CONTINUED
9. Allopurinol 100 mg PO daily — CONTINUED
10. Acetaminophen 650 mg PO q6h PRN pain — CONTINUED
11. Senna 8.6 mg PO nightly PRN — CONTINUED

No medications were started, stopped, or dose-changed at discharge.

FOLLOW-UP:
1. Cardiology (Dr. Okafor, Calverton Cardiology Associates, 555-0142): appointment scheduled 08/09/2026 at 10:30 AM.
2. PCP (Dr. Patel): within 14 days — office notified via portal, patient to be called with appointment.
3. Basic metabolic panel on 08/07/2026 — order placed at Calverton outpatient lab; results to Dr. Okafor.

DIET/ACTIVITY: 2 g sodium diet. Daily weights; call cardiology for gain > 1.5 kg in 3 days.
WARNING SIGNS REVIEWED: worsening shortness of breath, chest pain, weight gain, leg swelling.

Patient verbalized understanding of the plan. Discharged home in stable condition.

Electronically signed: R. Okafor, MD — 08/02/2026 16:41
